source_context.block_title: It's time for a Shake Up
It's time for a Shake Up

source_context.item_title: For anyone who loves relaxing in the sun, the fore deck of the Axopar 25 is the perfect escape. Positioned above the cuddy cabin, it offers a generous, open platform designed for effortless lounging.
A driver‑focused helm that gives you instant confidence. Smart ergonomics, easy‑to‑read instruments, and a balanced driving position make the Axopar 25 a pleasure to operate in all conditions.
The perfect upgrade for long days on the water. The top‑loaded refrigerator keeps drinks chilled, while the integrated sink adds practical convenience for quick rinsing and simple prep.
The platform that enables all the fun, from spending quality time with the family, to stand-up paddleboarding or diving.
The Multi Storage Compartment option offers plenty of space to store watersports gear, but it also serves as a great hang-out area on the boat.
